faq.q: What is the origin of Safet?
faq.a: Safet is associated with Arabic. Safet is the Bosnian form of Arabic صَفْوَة (Ṣafwa), meaning 'purity, choicest part'.
Yes — the underlying form صَفْوَت is Arabic.
